scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

MCP_TOKEN.description: Long random bearer token for `/mcp`. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. HTTPS URL to POST when mail arrives.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. HMAC secret for the inbound webhook.

WEBHOOK_BEARER.description: Optional. Bearer token the webhook receiver expects.

ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS.description: Exact addresses, `@domain` / `*@domain`, or `*`. Remove `allowed_destination_addresses` unless every entry is exact.

R2.description: R2 bucket for raw mail and attachments.
